commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/bloomml-mpc-hourly.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 1 --single-branch --branch research/simulator-fidelity-kaggle-20261103 https://github.com/MichalMatu/bloomml.git "$WORK/source"
cd "$WORK/source"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "02ac7e244272db69e6649a37fd9c5ad272185723"
printf 'MPC_EXTENDED_SOURCE_SHA|%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
python3 -m compileall -q tools/ml/mpc tests/test_mpc_device_responses.py tests/test_mpc_lab_observability.py
python3 -m unittest -q tests.test_mpc_devices tests.test_mpc_optimizer_mock tests.test_mpc_baselines tests.test_mpc_device_responses tests.test_mpc_physics_integration tests.test_mpc_lab_observability
echo 'MPC_EXTENDED_TESTS|PASS'
set +e
python3 -m tools.ml.mpc.cli --hours 1 --step-s 60 --seed 1729 --output-dir "$WORK/pilot" > "$WORK/cli.log" 2>&1
RC=$?
set -e
if test "$RC" -ne 0 -a "$RC" -ne 2; then cat "$WORK/cli.log"; printf 'MPC_1H_TOOL_FAILURE|%s\n' "$RC"; exit 73; fi
python3 - "$WORK/pilot" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json,math,sys
base=Path(sys.argv[1]); manifest=json.loads((base/'manifest.json').read_text())
assert manifest['source_commit']=='02ac7e244272db69e6649a37fd9c5ad272185723'
assert manifest['config']['steps']==60
assert manifest['synthetic_uncalibrated'] is True and manifest['physical_validation_with_real_data'] is False
for policy in ('mpc','threshold','hysteresis'):
 data=[json.loads(s) for s in (base/(policy+'.ndjson')).read_text().splitlines()]
 assert len(data)==60
 assert all(r['source_commit']=='02ac7e244272db69e6649a37fd9c5ad272185723' for r in data)
 assert all(math.isfinite(r['water_residual_kg']) and abs(r['water_residual_kg'])<1e-7 for r in data)
 assert all(r['virtual_execution_status']=='simulated_applied' for r in data)
 assert all(r['status'] in ('PASS','FAIL','BLOCKED','UNKNOWN') for r in data)
 report=manifest['baselines'][policy]
 assert report['steps']==60
 print('MPC_1H_METRIC|'+json.dumps({'policy':policy,**report},sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')))
 if policy=='mpc':
  assert all(r['prediction_uncertainty']=='synthetic_uncalibrated' for r in data)
  assert all(r['one_step_prediction_error'] is not None for r in data if r['predictions'])
  print('MPC_1H_MAX_FORECAST_RESIDUAL_C|'+str(max(abs(r['one_step_prediction_error']['temperature_c']) for r in data if r['one_step_prediction_error'])))
print('MPC_1H_EVIDENCE_MANIFEST|PASS')
PY
printf 'MPC_1H_CLI_GATE_EXIT|%s\n' "$RC"
